The assistant also provides real-world examples for both types of reactions, which helps to illustrate the concepts. Furthermore, the assistant only provides examples of exothermic reactions, and all of these examples are essentially the same (burning of different materials). The assistant also repeats the same examples multiple times, which adds no value to the response.
